'''Tewn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. While on [[Berrol's Donn/Legends|Berrol's Donn]], he served under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zeke Rondel]].
